caseName: Amalgamated Ass'n of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employees of America, Division 1267 v. Dade County
caseNameFull: Amalgamated Association of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employees of America, Division 1267 v. Dade County
attorneys: Bernard Cushman, Edward D. Cowart and Mozart G. Ratner for petitioner. Darrey A. Davis for respondents. Solicitor General Cox, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli and Norton J. Come filed a memorandum for the National Labor Relations Board.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to supplement petition for writ of certiorari granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida denied.
